question.body:
A tank contains 125 gallons of heating oil at time $t = 0$. During the time interval $0 <= t <= 12$ hours, heating oil is pumped into the tank at the rate $ H(t)= 2 + frac(10,(1 + ln(t + 1))) " gallons per hour " $ During the same time interval, heating oil is removed from the tank at the rate $ R(t)= 12 sin lr((frac(t^(2),47))) " gallons per hour. " $

(a) How many gallons of heating oil are pumped into the tank during the time interval $0 <= t <= 12$ hours?

(b) Is the level of heating oil in the tank rising or falling at time $t = 6$ hours? Give a reason for your answer.

(c) How many gallons of heating oil are in the tank at time $t = 12$ hours?

(d) At what time $t$, for $0 <= t <= 12$, is the volume of heating oil in the tank the least? Show the analysis that leads to your conclusion.
